channel.description: The Moscow Times News এর সর্বশেষ খবর

item.title: Russian Military Flotilla Bound for Libya Turns Around After Warship Sunk, Sources Say
item.description: A convoy of Russian ships carrying military vehicles bound for Libya has turned around in the Mediterranean after Ukrainian maritime drones sank a Russian naval corvette in Benghazi port on Nov. 22, three people from military and security services told Reuters on Friday.

item.title: Russia Accuses Latvia of Obstructing Grain Transit, Aiding Ukrainian Drone Attacks
item.description: Russia's Foreign Ministry accused Latvia on Friday of creating artificial obstacles to hinder the transit of Russian grain to global markets, saying the restrictions posed additional risks to global food security.

item.title: Justice Ministry Designates Left-Wing Media Outlet Rabkor as ‘Foreign Agent’
item.description: Rabkor was founded by jailed anti-war sociologist and Marxist theorist Boris Kagarlitsky.

item.title: Russia Extends Jet Fuel Export Ban Until March 2027
item.description: Moscow first banned jet fuel exports in June after Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries led to slumps in domestic production and shortages.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine Exchange Over 40 Elderly Civilians in Belarus
item.description: The International Committee of the Red Cross said the exchange was part of ongoing humanitarian efforts to help reunite people from the two warring countries with their relatives.

item.title: Crimean Court Jails 4 Jehovah’s Witnesses for ‘Extremism’
item.description: The jail terms are some of the longest handed down to members of the religious movement since it was outlawed by Russia in 2017.

item.title: Drone Strikes Kill 2 in Kursk and Bryansk Regions Amid Overnight Attacks
item.description: In St. Petersburg, falling drone debris reportedly wounded a 44-year-old woman after damaging an apartment building.

item.title: Russia Bans Buckwheat Exports Until Mid-2027
item.description: The government cited a declining harvest and shrinking stockpiles for introducing the export ban.

item.title: Former Tambov Region Governor Jailed 11 Years for Bribery
item.description: Maxim Yegorov served as governor from October 2021 until his sudden resignation in November 2024.

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Sparks Fire and Inflicts Serious Damage at Krasnodar Refinery
item.description: The company operating the refinery said the attack took place during a maintenance stoppage that has been in place since a previous drone strike in September.

item.title: Finland Extends Russian Border Closure for Another 2 Years
item.description: The Nordic country said the widely anticipated move was necessary to “combat attempts to put pressure on Finland, strengthen border security and help Finland prepare for the most serious incidents of instrumentalized migration.”

item.title: Blackout Hits Annexed Crimea After Morning Air Raid
item.description: Local utilities providers attributed the power outage to an “accident” at energy facilities “outside” the peninsula.

item.title: Russia Lost Track of a Beloved Seal. Scientists Lost a Window Into the Wild.
item.description: A French satellite operator’s cutoff left Kroshik’s rescuers unable to track him and disrupted research on everything from Lake Baikal’s seals to Arctic sea ice.

item.title: PM Pashinyan Reaffirms Armenia’s EU Ambitions Ahead of Putin Meeting
item.description: Pashinyan also repeated plans to gradually end Armenia’s decades-long reliance on Russian border guards, who patrol its border with Turkey and Iran.

item.title: Russian TV Star With Ties to VTB Chief Backed Telegram’s Failed Crypto Venture – Report
item.description: A 2019 report by Deutsche Bank’s financial crime unit listed Nailya Asker-Zade among investors it flagged as raising concerns.
